To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the effect of inbound open technology acquisition on firm performance is mediated by the horizontal technology collaboration, and that the effect of vertical technology collaboration on firm performance is also mediated by horizontal technology collaboration.
inbound open innovation has a positive effect on firm performance.
inbound open innovation can be an important source of competitive advantage for high tech firms.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effect of inbound open innovations on firm performance, and the role of external knowledge resources as a mediator of the performance effect.
the impact of technology scouting on the acquisition of horizontal and vertical technology collaborations and its effect on firm performance.
the effect of inbound open technology acquisition on firm performance and the underlying mechanisms of such effect.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the more a firm can build external connection channels and the more it can leverage these connections through inbound open innovation, the higher its innovation performance.
the more the firm is able to acquire external knowledge resources, the better the performance.
the technology scouting activities of a firm are important in determining the firm's performance.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the ability to scout technology opportunities and the ability to develop external technology collaboration channels are important for a firm to achieve better performance from its inbound open innovation.
the ability to identify and access external knowledge is the key to successful inbound open innovation.

technology scouting is a key antecedent of horizontal and vertical technology collaboration, and the latter two are important mediating mechanisms for technology acquisitions to influence firm performance.
The main takeaway from our work is that
firms should be more proactive in their external technology scouting and collaboration efforts to enhance their performance.
technology scouting and collaboration with external partners can enhance a firm's ability to acquire external knowledge resources and deploy such knowledge to achieve superior performance.
the ability to acquire and deploy external knowledge resources through inbound open innovation is a key factor in determining superior firm performance.
